blocks.text: Photo courtesy of the Office of Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano and Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Wednesday raised concerns over corruption and political divisions in the country, calling for accountability, unity, and prayer. Speaking at the 51st National Prayer Breakfast, Hontiveros cited Filipinos who gathered in public demonstrations to demand accountability over alleged irregularities in flood control projects. She also pointed to community pantries established during the COVID-19 pandemic and the efforts of ordinary Filipinos to help flood-affected neighbors as examples of people looking after one another despite difficult circumstances.
